description: The Mahogany Room — a complete, interactive 3D snooker game in the browser with 22 balls, Three.js rendering, Cannon.js physics, spin, a referee, an AI opponent and portable career stats.

tokens.note: Snapshot from the OpenCode session record when the project was packaged. total = input + output + reasoning. Cache reads/writes are reported separately because they are a subset of context usage.

cost.note: As reported by the OpenCode session record.

game.table: 12 ft × 6 ft playing area (3.569 m × 1.778 m)
controls: Shot tool: hold cloth to charge, release
game.ballSizeNote: Slightly oversized at 60 mm for readability; brightened colours with a warm Fresnel rim light.
game.aiming: Aim tool for relative drag/click/wheel; Scene for orbit; Shot for hold-and-release; stable camera; sticky pin; one mouse.
game.ballReadability: Saturated 60 mm balls, brighter emissive, neutral key light, darker baize, white Fresnel rim and dark contour.

tested: AI legal break and foul handling
fixed camera while moving the mouse
Scene drag orbits without changing aim
Shot hold-to-charge fires and returns to Aim
quick click in Shot mode cancels with a hint
quick click in Shot mode cancels
Scene → Aim preserves the exact camera framing and shot angle
referee call explains legal points and fouls
wrong-ball foul shows blue value and player two beneficiary
wrong-ball foul shows blue value and Player Two beneficiary
